name: Niedax
verdict: Owned by the Niedax Group, a 100% family-owned German cable-management manufacturer. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Family-owned German cable-management group (Niedax GmbH & Co. KG, Linz am Rhein); no state or fund ownership found in its chain. Official sleeve partner of Bayer 04 Leverkusen since 2024/25 (contract to 30 June 2027).
